summary: Saint Louis County tower marked gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no other source about it was found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no other source describes the tower or its site.

evidence.supports: Savage tower in Saint Louis County at these coordinates, marked gone

notes_for_editor: Only one source, a county list with a name, coordinates and status. Two searches and the 2019 Minnesota study found nothing else about a Savage tower in Saint Louis County. The story is about 40 words, below the 120-word floor, because the evidence is that thin. Unopened search snippets, not cited, describe a standing Savage fire tower near Pequot Lakes in Crow Wing County, a different tower with the same name; the Saint Louis County point may be a mix-up with another record and is worth checking against DNR records.
